messages:
maria-ops: Heads-up — we need to schedule a post-incident review for the outage yesterday (paging storm -> degraded inference). Who can facilitate? I'm available Tue/Wed afternoon PT.

incident-bot: Incident 4521 summary: partial degradation of vector-serving pool causing 20-40% increased latency; automated fallback activated. Timeline + logs: https://incidents.example/4521 (auto-posted).

sam-platform: I can facilitate but prefer Wed 3pm PT. Could someone from SRE join (tomasz)?

tomasz-sre: I can do Wed 3-5pm PT. Also suggest 30-45m, exec summary + action item triage.

priya-prod: Wed 3pm PT works for product. I'll prepare the customer impact timeline and highlight the 3 top affected flows.

alisha-support: I'll gather top customer tickets and include redacted transcripts. Also can present our comms sent so far and outstanding asks.

maria-ops: OK Wed 3pm PT it is. @sam-platform volunteered to facilitate. @incident-bot please create calendar event and add agenda template.

incident-bot: Created event: "Post-Incident Review: Incident 4521" Wed, 15:00 PT — 16:00 PT. Attendees: maria-ops, sam-platform, priya-prod, tomasz-sre, alisha-support. Calendar link: https://cal.example/evt/4521. Agenda template attached to event.

jon-engr: Quick note — infra owner for the vector-serving cluster (Arman) is OOO until Thu. For deep RCA we'll need his input; can we record and allow async comments?

maria-ops: Yes record + async comments. @sam-platform can you take notes and create the postmortem doc? Use the standard template in docs/incidents/postmortem-template. Also add a short "what to tell customers" section.

sam-platform: Will do. I'll start the doc and add sections: timeline, customer impact, mitigation steps, RCA hypotheses, action items. Planning to assign initial owners for each action.

sam-platform: Calendar/event payload I'm attaching for the invite:
```
Title: Post-Incident Review: Incident 4521
When: Wed 2025-06-11 15:00-16:00 PT
Where: Zoom (link in event)
Agenda:
 - 3m: Quick recap and scope
 - 15m: Timeline walk-through
 - 20m: RCA discussion and evidence
 - 10m: Action item assignment + owners + due dates
 - 2m: Communications plan and next steps
```

priya-prod: Add a line in agenda for "customer impact quant + top customers affected" (5m) — I can do that.

tomasz-sre: Suggest we tag metric owners for the two dashboards that alerted (latency.jit and kv-cache-hit). Also recommend including recent kernel/driver upgrade notes in RCA.

maria-ops: Quick RSVP check: please react with :thumbsup: if you can attend live, :eyes: if you'll attend async.

alisha-support: :thumbsup: — I'll be there and will share ticket excerpts.

tomasz-sre: :thumbsup:

priya-prod: :thumbsup:

sam-platform: :thumbsup: (taking facilitation + notes)

jon-engr: :eyes: — I'll watch the recording and add notes after since Arman will join async.

maria-ops: Thanks — Sam you're facilitator; Priya will lead comms; Tomasz infra follow-up; Alisha will present customer tickets. Sam, please publish the postmortem doc and ping #pagerduty when it's ready so others can pre-read.

sam-platform: Draft created: https://docs.example/postmortems/4521 — added timeline, a preliminary RCA hypothesis (KV cache eviction + request routing regression), and tentative action items with owners and 1-week SLAs. Will refine before the meeting.

sam-platform: Initial action items (short):
 - Tomasz: Add KV cache instrumentation and alert (owner: tomasz-sre, due: 1 week)
 - Priya: Draft customer comms + approval path (owner: priya-prod, due: 3 days)
 - Alisha: Compile top 10 tickets + transcripts (owner: alisha-support, due: 48h)
 - Maria: Run postmortem facilitator retrospective and update rotation schedule (owner: maria-ops, due: 2 weeks)

maria-ops: Perfect. If anyone needs to transfer ownership of an action, please edit the doc with the "Owner" field and ping me. We'll also track remediation in the quarterly reliability board if scope >1 sprint.

sam-platform: Added recording permission note and asked Arman to drop async comments under the "RCA evidence" section. I'll also link logs and the rollout window.

maria-ops: Thanks everyone. Meeting is set — see you Wed. I'll post a short pre-read reminder 24h before.

(threads ends)
